answer: Give each new identity zero trust and let standing grow only through endorsements from established, unrelated peers: a voucher stakes its own reputation, so one bad vouch burns the voucher too. A fake swarm then needs many real sponsors, and one exposed forgery sends a ripple through its whole sponsor graph, collapsing every connected sockpuppet at once. Like a sonnet, the form is strict with no shortcuts, and like saffron, real standing is costly to grow and easy to spoil.
